We're It...! | enva=[[Billy Regan]]| java=[[Kōzō Mito]] | }} '''Conway''' (Japanese: '''コウヘイ''' ''Kōhei'') is a recurring character in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] who first appeared in ''[[DP050|Tag! We're It...!]]'' as {{an|Dawn}}'s [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] partner. ==History== [[File:Conway and Dawn.png|thumb|left|220px|Conway and Dawn]] Conway first appeared from ''[[DP050|Tag! We're It...!]]'' to ''[[DP052|Smells Like Team Spirit!]]''. He was shown to be a very smart Trainer, his strategies playing an important role in helping himself and {{an|Dawn}} to advance to the finals of the [[Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition]], where they would end up losing to {{Ash}} and [[Paul]]. [[File:Conway and Ash.png|thumb|250px|Conway and Ash]] Conway appeared again in ''[[DP088|Camping It Up!]]'' through ''[[DP091|One Team, Two Team, Red Team, Blue Team!]]'' during a four-episode arc at the [[Pokémon Summer Academy]]. During this arc, he demonstrated his knowledge about Pokémon as well as an attraction towards Dawn. He later appeared in ''[[DP182|An Old Family Blend!]]'', where it was revealed that he was also entering the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. In ''[[DP183|League Unleashed!]]'', he passed the first round, then in ''[[DP184|Casting a Paul on Barry!]]'', he made it through the second and had his third round opponent, Ash. He battled Ash and lost in ''[[DP185|Working on a Right Move!]]'' after almost defeating him thanks to his strategies. He made a cameo appearance in the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. {{left clear}} ==Character== The most notable thing about Conway is his habit of appearing out of nowhere, which {{an|Dawn}} finds creepy. He is remarkably intelligent, and uses effective strategies such as using {{m|Trick Room}} to his {{p|Dusknoir}}'s advantage. However, he is bad at improvisation which led to his elimination from the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]] in ''[[DP185|Working on a Right Move!]]''. He also has a habit of adjusting his glasses and chuckling in a creepy manner, which is displayed every time he appears. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Conway's known Pokémon: ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Conway |pkmn=Slowking |type1=Water |type2=Psychic |img=Conway Slowking.png |epnum=DP050 |epname=Tag! We're It...! |desc=When {{an|Dawn}} first met Conway, {{p|Slowking}} was with him and Dawn thought both were creepy, but Conway told her that Slowking had taken a liking to her. During their first battle, Conway told Dawn to not worry about defense; their strategy being her {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}} would use offensive moves, while Slowking kept on defending him with attacks like Safeguard. It was later shown to have helped [[Dawn's Buneary]] beat Conway and Dawn's semi-final round opponents, in ''[[DP052|Smells Like Team Spirit!]]''. It was later seen again in ''[[DP089|Up Close and Personable!]]'', in the [[Pokémon Summer Academy]] where it showed off some impressive moves against [[Jessie's Yanmega]]; protecting a {{p|Lumineon}} that he, Ash, and {{ashfr}} had found in a cave. It was seen for the last time in ''[[DP091|One Team, Two Team, Red Team, Blue Team!]]''; running alongside Conway in the third leg of the triathlon. Slowking's known moves are {{m|Safeguard}}, {{m|Protect}}, {{m|Psychic}}, and {{m|Water Pulse}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Conway |pkmn=Aggron |type1=Steel |type2=Rock |img=Conway Aggron.png |epnum=DP051 |epname=Glory Blaze! |vajp= |vaen=Carter Cathcart{{!}}Billy Beach |desc=Not much is known about Conway's {{p|Aggron}}. None of Aggron's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Conway |pkmn=Heracross |type1=Bug |type2=Fighting |gender=male |img=Conway Heracross.png |epnum=DP052 |epname=Smells Like Team Spirit! |desc={{p|Heracross}} was first seen in Conway and Dawn's [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] against [[Paul]] and {{Ash}}; alongside {{TP|Dawn|Buizel}}. Heracross, though putting up a great fight, was finally taken down by a direct hit from Chimchar's {{m|Flamethrower}}. Heracross's known moves are {{m|Revenge}}, {{m|Feint}}, and {{m|Megahorn}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Conway |pkmn=Shuckle |type1=Bug |type2=Rock |img=Conway Shuckle.png |epnum=DP185 |epname=Working on a Right Move! |vajp=Ikue Otani |vaen=Tom Wayland |desc={{p|Shuckle}} was Conway's first Pokémon in his battle against {{Ash}} in the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. Its offensive and defensive capabilities proved it to be a tough opponent, making Ash switch through his three Pokémon, {{AP|Noctowl}}, {{AP|Donphan}} and {{AP|Gible}}. While its {{m|Gyro Ball}} was able to deal a lot of damage to the first two, Gible was able to stop the attack by biting Shuckle. It was eventually defeated with a {{m|Draco Meteor}}. Shuckle's known moves are {{m|Withdraw}}, {{m|Power Trick}}, {{m|Sludge Bomb}}, and {{m|Gyro Ball}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Conway |pkmn=Lickilicky |type1=Normal |img=Conway Lickilicky.png |epnum=DP185 |epname=Working on a Right Move! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Lickilicky}} was sent out after Shuckle was defeated. It used {{m|Lick}} on Gible, confusing it. Ash had to send back Gible, after Lickilicky attacked it using {{m|Power Whip}}. He sent out Noctowl, which Lickilicky tried to attack with its tongue. It wasn't long enough, and Noctowl was able to dodge its Thunderbolt and defeat it with {{m|Extrasensory}}. Lickilicky's known moves are {{m|Lick}}, {{m|Power Whip}}, and {{m|Thunderbolt}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Conway |pkmn=Dusknoir |type1=Ghost |img=Conway Dusknoir.png |epnum=DP185 |epname=Working on a Right Move! |vajp= |vaen=Marc Thompson |desc={{p|Dusknoir}} was the last Pokémon that Conway used in the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. It automatically used Trick Room and knocked out Noctowl with Thunder Punch. It was also able to defeat Donphan with a combination of Mean Look and Shadow Punch. However, Gible was able to pin down Dusknoir by biting its hand. It then used Draco Meteor and finished Dusknoir off with {{m|Dragon Pulse}}. Dusknoir's known moves are {{m|Trick Room}}, {{m|Thunder Punch}}, {{m|Shadow Punch}}, and {{m|Mean Look}}.}} ===Temporary=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Conway |pkmn=Venonat |type1=Bug |type2=Poison |img=Conway Venonat.png |epnum=DP088 |epname=Camping It Up! |vaen=Rachael Lillis |desc={{p|Venonat}} was first seen in ''[[DP088|Camping It Up!]]'' where it was temporarily used in the [[Pokémon Summer Academy]]. Venonat's known moves are {{m|Psychic}}, {{m|Stun Spore}}, and {{m|Supersonic}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Conway |pkmn=Dugtrio |type1=Ground |img=Conway Dugtrio.png |epnum=DP091 |epname=One Team, Two Team, Red Team, Blue Team! |vaen=Eric Stuart |desc={{p|Dugtrio}} was first seen in ''[[DP091|One Team, Two Team, Red Team, Blue Team!]]'' where Conway used it in the first leg of the triathlon of the [[Pokémon Summer Academy]]. None of Dugtrio's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Conway |pkmn=Floatzel |type1=Water |img=Conway Floatzel.png |epnum=DP091 |epname=One Team, Two Team, Red Team, Blue Team! |desc={{p|Floatzel}} was first seen in ''[[DP091|One Team, Two Team, Red Team, Blue Team!]]'' where Conway used it in the second leg of the Triathlon of the [[Pokémon Summer Academy]].
